issue.body:
Here is problematic code 

https://gist.github.com/anonymous/b5adea698d297d8cc8ca

The same code was working on another project. (Maybe problem occurred because of update). The problem is HTML:a with data method POST inside ActiveForm submits wrapping form. After moving tis part out of wrapping form all works.

https://gist.github.com/anonymous/daa2d3bba0ea0f0fe8e6

Question is, why a submits wrapping form?
